lower_third: Built from reported cases: fake bank-agent calls, cloned voices, fake transfer alerts.

scenes.title: 1. The call
sentences: Your phone rings.
A man from your bank says your account will be blocked in one hour, unless you read him a code.
People lose their savings to calls like this.
Knowing the advice is not the same as practicing it.
This is Scam Gym.

scenes.title: 2. Going wrong
sentences: This is the bank call.
He sounds official, sets a deadline, and tries to scare me.
I'm busy and worried, so I give my date of birth.
Then he asks for the code, and I read it out.
And this is where the money would be gone.

scenes.title: 3. The debrief
sentences: Then the part that matters.
Scam Gym walks back through the call and names each pressure tactic: fake authority, a deadline, fear, fake proof.
Each one comes with a plain explanation, and the safer reply that was there all along.

scenes.title: 4. Same call, handled well
sentences: Same call, handled well.
I hang up and call the number on my card.
Safe exit, and one habit to keep: a real bank never asks for your code.

scenes.title: 5. The seller drill
sentences: Shop owners and POS agents are targeted with fake transfer alerts.
In this drill, a customer rushes me with an alert message.
I check my own banking app, not the message.
A message is not money.

scenes.title: 6. Languages and family code
sentences: It runs in English, Spanish and French, by voice or by tapping, and keeps working offline.
For the cloned-voice call, it helps a family choose a code word, with a message ready to share.

scenes.title: 7. Evidence
sentences: We tested it with {n} volunteers.
Before playing, {pre} percent chose to verify.
After two drills, {post} percent did.
It is a small, self-reported sample.
It shows promise, not proof.

scenes.title: 8. Honest limits
sentences: Everything is fictional.
There are no accounts, nothing is stored, and voice is optional.
One honest limitation: Scam Gym builds a habit under simulated pressure.
A real caller with a spoofed number may still sound more convincing than any drill.
Built between October seventeenth and now, with AI coding assistance from Claude Code.
Scam Gym.
Practice the call before the scammer makes it.
